harness_spec.goal: Local resolution of e6-t12 under the current topology

nodes.instructions: Acquire all governed evidence for the task.
Resolve every unresolved distinction from local evidence; persist the resolution.
Deterministically verify the resolution against the task deliverable.
Return the verified result into the governed boundary.

predictions.claim: distinction Q1 (How many responses in artifacts/server.log carry a 5xx status code?) is resolved by node resolve-local
predictions.observable: post-execution resolved/unresolved distinction record and evidence provenance
predictions.success_condition: Q1 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to resolve-local
predictions.falsification_condition: Q1 appears in unresolved_distinctions after execution, or its evidence is not attributable to resolve-local

predictions.success_condition: node completion order equals a legal linearization of ['observe-evidence', 'resolve-local', 'verify-resolution', 'return-result']
predictions.falsification_condition: any completion outside the compiled LTS (REFINEMENT_VIOLATION) or a node absent from the realized branch

predictions.claim: execution uses at most 1 model calls
no actor exceeds its authority envelope
predictions.observable: formal check results over the execution ledger
predictions.falsification_condition: any authority escalation, non-gate promotion, or attenuation failure

predictions.claim: local evidence is sufficient: resolution and verification complete without any descendant
predictions.success_condition: verification completes with zero child launches
predictions.falsification_condition: verification is impossible from local evidence, or a distinction requires an isolated source

falsifiers: a distinction in ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'] remains unresolved after execution
the runtime path violates the compiled LTS
